sampling.algorithm: accepted shifted-Halton 256-row pool without reusable canonical boundary points; raw[0:96] development/calibration, then six lowest-index remaining interpolation rows, five smallest coordinate-to-boundary-distance rows, and five largest nearest-candidate-distance rows with hash tie-breaks

geometry.family: fresh seed, accepted L1a-v2 bounded 11-variable PPM-stack construction
geometry.pairing: low and high problems share geometry_sha256 and signed ampere-turns; coarse bands use a preregistered 0.0016 m radial smear required by the 41-node radial grid

fidelities.interpolation: exact nested-grid bilinear prolongation; coincident nodes copied exactly

outputs.field: concatenated Br,Bz on fixed accepted high-fidelity mesh

candidate_models.selection: smallest budget passing all development gates; then minimum worst scalar NRMSE, field L2, lexical family

uncertainty.coverage_gate: each assessment group observed coverage >=0.6 and exact-rank interval recorded
uncertainty.width_gate: median and p95 full width normalized by development range <=0.30 and <=0.60

gates.decision_safety: no point is surrogate-acceptable when assessment stratum is OOD or topology uncertainty/mismatch is flagged

latency.comparison: coarse solve plus all scalar/field inference and safety checks versus high solve

integrity.protocol_commit_subject: preregister L1a field surrogate v1 experiment
integrity.results_commit_subject: record L1a field surrogate v1 results
integrity.full_git_blob_closure: all HEAD blobs under new experiment/tests and imported accepted package roots recorded before label access
integrity.results: strict JSON, SHA-256 sidecars, manifest closure, model hashes, viewer-ready representative predictions

claim_limits: The high-fidelity target is the accepted L1a numerical discretization, not physical truth.
No material, plasma, thermal, structural, propulsion or hardware accuracy is claimed.
Accepted L1a-v2 results are disclosed development evidence only and provide no labels.
